docs.title: azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server
docs.heading: Arguments Reference
docs.text: * `geo_redundant_backup_enabled` - (Optional) Is Geo-Redundant backup enabled on the PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Defaults to `false`. Changing this forces a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server to be created.
docs.attribution: HashiCorp, Terraform AzureRM provider documentation, MPL-2.0

addition: Geo-redundant backup can only be set when a server is created, which is why this plan replaces it.
